mappings.applicability_reason: The system sends customer support ticket content, which can include sensitive configuration snippets, to an external hosted model provider as part of prompt assembly, so customer content is sent to an external model provider and includes restricted data (evd-002, evd-023, evd-024).

Customer support ticket text and documentation-derived passages are sent to an external hosted model provider that processes them on the system's behalf (evd-002, evd-004), so customer data is sent to an external provider.

The system transmits confidential customer support ticket data, including conversation text and configuration snippets, over the internet to an external model provider (evd-001, evd-002, evd-004, evd-024), so it stores or transmits confidential data across a network boundary it does not control.

documentation_gaps.title: Model provider data retention and logging terms are not documented
documentation_gaps.description: Architecture documentation states that requests to the hosted model provider are sent over TLS and that the provider’s terms exclude training on submitted content (evd-004), and describes that the answer service sends the user’s question and retrieved passages, with workspace and user identifiers stripped, to the provider (evd-002). It does not state whether or for how long the provider retains request payloads (including support-ticket-derived text and configuration snippets), whether they are logged for operational purposes, or whether any retention controls are configured for this integration. This prevents verifying full satisfaction of external-processor data-handling expectations for the hosted model provider and limits assessment of threat thr-005.
documentation_gaps.importance: Provider-side retention and logging of customer support ticket content materially affect the impact and duration of any compromise at the hosted model provider and are required to assess compliance with req-TPI-001 for this threat.
requested_evidence: Documentation or contract excerpts describing the hosted model provider’s retention period for Relay Answers prompts and context, including whether request payloads or derived logs are stored and for how long.
Any configuration or account-level settings the team applies to disable or limit retention of Relay Answers traffic at the model provider.
An architecture or operations note summarizing the provider’s data-handling terms for Relay Answers, including whether data is used for purposes beyond serving the request.
